caption:
Why is an ₹8 lakh car not ₹8 lakh? | On-Road Price Explained

The ad shows the ex-showroom price. Your bill adds one-time road tax, insurance, registration and extras.
Illustrative: an ₹8 lakh petrol car registered in an individual's name in Maharashtra. Road tax at 11% = ₹88,000. The compulsory 3-year third-party cover for a 1000–1500 cc car = ₹10,640. That is ₹8,98,640 before own-damage cover, registration fees, accessories or handling charges.
Road tax differs by state, fuel and price. Ask the dealer for an itemised on-road quote, and compare insurance quotes for the same cover.
